subject: Quote CGN-LOS
body:
Dear team,

we need a price for 3 crates of pump spare parts from Cologne (CGN) to Lagos (LOS), 410 kg, 1.9 cbm, delivered to CGN by us, ready 26.11.2026.

Transit time must not exceed 3 days. Among the airlines that make it in 3 days or less, please offer the cheapest. All-in in EUR.

Best regards
Marco Lenz
Export
Rheinberg Pumpen AG
